resources.string: Tap to select, hold and drag for multiple blocks

Tap a block to select or deselect it. Hold and drag across blocks to toggle their states: unselected blocks become selected, and selected blocks become unselected. Each block toggles only once per drag. Drag near a list edge to keep scrolling. One undo reverses an entire drag. Copied text keeps its original order and the formatting within consecutive selected blocks.
